exercises.goal: Combine partial views of the same customers without confusing source identity, foreign keys, and field authority.

Use globally unique CustomerRef for Odoo res.partner.ref. Company operation context is a separate choice.
Choose explicit output names for other RecId, Name, and Status fields; do not coalesce.
Lowercase email, clean phones, uppercase countries, trim names, and replace the exact placeholder UNKNOW with blank.
Choose an explicit blank policy for empty email and optional Chain.

products_core.Name is authoritative; product_details.Name is a separate export label.

Match Article and Service against captured choices for each verified Odoo major.
Explicitly match PCE to existing Units; do not create another unit.
Map category using complete intended hierarchy.

The selected operation company does not silently assign a record company or replace the related record scope.

Split repeated header data into six headers and retain all 24 component rows.

Load product templates and confirm generated variants before component relationships.

Map PaymentTermCode to the supplier field, not to the similarly named customer field.

execution_scope.operation_company: One verified operation company per authoring load or Recipe run. CompanyCode does not change operation context row-by-row.
execution_scope.review_population: Source combination reviews cover both companies (18 customers/32 products); company-specific target mappings use Rows to use/row-inclusion filters before preparation.
execution_scope.supporting_inputs: When a company-filtered exercise retains both-company enrichment inputs, keep every-added-row-must-be-represented off. Exactly one matching row per included primary record is still required.
execution_scope.customer_mapping_filter: Combined customer CompanyCode equals the selected company. Retain AccountNum, CustomerRef, Party and company scope as distinct concepts.
execution_scope.manufacturing_mapping_filter: Product, BoM header, component and operation CompanyCode equals the selected company. Shared categories and UoM are independent shared-reference stages.
execution_scope.cross_company_products: Products have globally prefixed refs and no target company assignment in the declared intent. The source CompanyCode filter divides exercises; all required components across both partitions must be present before BoM comparison. Either complete both product runs first or seed the explicitly needed shared components.
execution_scope.recipe_scope: Each company receives a separate run with its company fixed after activation. Reuse portable keys against fresh captured evidence.
execution_scope.patch_scope: NORTH only; all6 patch refs belong to NORTH.
execution_scope.counts: Use expected-business-results.json company_execution_projections for executable exercise totals. Aggregate expected_counts are business inventory controls across two separate company runs.
execution_scope.customer_target_company_assignment: No target company ownership assignment is implied. CompanyCode chooses source rows and scoped accounting references. A reviewed record-company assignment is a separate choice.

target_prerequisites.connection: LOCAL or REMOTE must be explicitly verified for the chosen target and major.
target_prerequisites.modules: Verify installed modules and edition capabilities from target metadata. base/contacts/product/mrp alone does not establish availability of account models or accounting features.
target_prerequisites.companies: Seed NORTH and SOUTH, grant the exercise user the intended company access, then choose one operation company per run.
target_prerequisites.selection_values: Match human labels to each target major's captured choices; do not reuse an Odoo19 alias as a version-neutral default.
target_prerequisites.accounting_limits: No tax correctness, fiscal-position tax mapping, localization completeness, or account hierarchy capability is asserted by these dummy names.
target_prerequisites.unsupported_capability: Mark the affected track Needs setup or not qualified if the verified target lacks fields/modules. Do not create invented Odoo fields to force a pass.
